cause: The browser vendors withdrew the plugin and the open web grew up without it.
name: Adobe Flash (.swf)
ritual: Leave a vector star and a loading bar that never quite finishes.

cause: The neighbourhoods were demolished when the hosting era that built them ended.
name: GeoCities
ritual: Leave a tiled star background and a guestbook nobody signed.

artifacts: screen names with too many numbers
cause: The phone in every pocket replaced the buddy list on every desktop.
name: AIM (AOL Instant Messenger)
ritual: Leave a yellow running man, mid-stride, forever.

cause: Broadband and better codecs ended the age of buffering as a lifestyle.
name: RealPlayer / RealMedia (.rm)
ritual: Leave a helix and ten seconds of glorious, blocky video.

cause: Its authoring world, Director, faded long before the player was switched off.
name: Shockwave (.dcr)
ritual: Leave a cast member waiting for a stage that never loads.

cause: Browsers removed the plugin bridge the applets needed to cross into the page.
name: Java Applets
ritual: Leave a grey rectangle where something wonderful used to run.

cause: Streaming moved to HTML5 and the plugin moon never rose again.
name: Microsoft Silverlight
ritual: Leave a small moon, eclipsed by a standard.

cause: Six seconds was a revolution its parent company chose not to keep.
name: Vine
ritual: Leave a loop that ends exactly where it begins.

cause: The feed era gave way to the algorithmic timeline.
name: Google Reader
ritual: Leave an RSS icon, still quietly glowing orange.

cause: The browser war it started was won by the browsers that came after it.
name: Netscape Navigator
ritual: Leave a comet that taught a generation the web could move.

cause: After years on life support, even its own maker asked the world to move on.
name: Internet Explorer
ritual: Leave a blue e with a gold swoosh, retired with honours and relief.

cause: A free encyclopedia anyone could edit outgrew the one pressed on discs.
name: Microsoft Encarta
ritual: Leave a castle door that opens onto the whole internet.

cause: Search consolidated around a single front door.
name: AltaVista
ritual: Leave a query box that once felt like a superpower.

cause: Its network merged into a video-calling future.
name: MSN / Windows Live Messenger
ritual: Leave a window shaking, gently, one last time.

cause: The graphical web burrowed past the menu-driven tunnels.
name: Gopher
ritual: Leave a tunnel map to a library that predates the page.

cause: The hand-built homepage era professionalised, then componentised.
name: Microsoft FrontPage
ritual: Leave a webbot component, still counting visitors somewhere.

cause: Streaming replaced the lovingly organised local MP3 library. The classic player was discontinued; the llama outlived us all in memory.
name: Winamp (classic)
ritual: Leave a skin and a milkdrop visualiser, playing to an empty room.

cause: Every phone became an editing suite.
name: Windows Movie Maker
ritual: Leave a star wipe over a sunset that needed no effects.
